verdict.rationale: ZCode's claimed docs describe multi-agent collaboration and a Goal mode that keeps planning, executing and verifying multi-step work. Users can also trigger tasks remotely via WeChat, Feishu or Telegram, which loosely covers autonomous build-and-test while away. However, the evidence shows the agent running on the user's own desktop, terminal or SSH/WSL host rather than as a cloud-hosted agent, and nothing shows it producing a demo for review. missing for 10: a cloud-hosted agent execution environment, an explicit build-and-test pipeline, demo artifacts (recordings, screenshots, preview links) for review, independent or hands-on corroboration.
